chunks.arabic_text: وَفِي رِوَايَةِ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ:

translations.en: And in the narration of Ribʿī ibn ʿAbd Allāh:

chunks.arabic_text: أَنَّهُ لَمَّا بَايَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ النِّسَاءَ وَأَخَذَ عَلَيْهِنَّ دَعَا بِإِنَاءٍ فَمَلَأَهُ ثُمَّ غَمَسَ يَدَهُ فِي الْإِنَاءِ ثُمَّ أَخْرَجَهَا فَأَمَرَهُنَّ أَنْ يُدْخِلْنَ أَيْدِيَهُنَّ فَيَغْمِسْنَ فِيهِ

translations.en: When the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله took the pledge of allegiance from the women and bound them to it, he called for a vessel and filled it. Then he dipped his hand into the vessel, then withdrew it, and instructed them to put their hands into it and immerse them in it.

chunks.arabic_text: وَكَانَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ وَيَرْدُدْنَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامَ وَكَانَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ وَكَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ عَلَى الشَّابَّةِ مِنْهُنَّ

translations.en: And he عليه السلام would greet women, and they would return the greeting. And Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام would greet women as well, but he disliked greeting the young women among them.

chunks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ «أَتَخَوَّفُ أَنْ يُعْجِبَنِي صَوْتُهَا فَيَدْخُلَ مِنَ الْإِثْمِ عَلَيَّ أَكْثَرُ مِمَّا أَطْلُبُ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ».

translations.en: And he said: "I fear that her voice may please me, and so there may come upon me from sin more than what I seek of reward."

en.summary: This hadith reports the method by which the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله took the pledge of allegiance from women without direct physical contact, using a vessel of water. It also describes the practice of greeting women and the caution of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام in avoiding situations that could lead to spiritual harm or sin.
en.seo_question: How did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله take bayʿah from women, and what did Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام say about greeting young women?

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.إِنَاءٍ: a vessel used here for the bayʿah procedure
key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
